fields.description: Program Description Introduction: Aiming at the comprehensive Chinese applying ability. Lay a solid foundation for foreign students when they are living and seeking for employment in China through hearing, speaking, reading and writing skill to improve their Chinese communicating skill and help them have a basic understanding of Chinese culture through courses and social activities. Main course: Preliminary Comprehensive Chinese, Preliminary Chinese speaking, Preliminary Chinese hearing, preliminary Chinese writing, HSK training, Chinese culture, Chinese panorama. Courses with Chinese Cultural Characteristics: Chinese traditional writing, Chinese cooking, Chinese diet and culture, Chinese mask-painting, paper-cut, teaism, Tai Chi, Chinese martial, traditional musical instrument, the appreciation of Chinese traditional architecture, etc.

fields.materials: Application Materials " * " means necessary documents that you must provide in your application. If you want to book our translation service , please pay and book it at least 2 weeks before the application deadline for submission of all documents; If you want to book our guardian service , you need to pay and book it 2 months before the application deadline, just in case your application fails because of failed to submit application documents in time. * 1. Passport-sized photo A passport-sized photo taken recently of the applicant. * 2. Photocopy of valid passport With name, passport number & expiration date, and photo included * 3. Certificate/diploma of highest education According to Liaoning Province Government Requirement: Graduation certificate in languages other than English or Chinese should be translated into Chinese and be certified by notarization. If you can not find translation organization, please contact CUCAS. Graduation certificate must be certified by the Chinese Embassy (Consulate) in your country or notarized by a notary office in China. * 4. Academic transcript of highest education According to Liaoning Province Government Requirement: academic transcript in languages other than English or Chinese should be translated into Chinese and be certified by notarization. If you can not find translation organization, please contact CUCAS. Transcripts must be certified by the Chinese Embassy (Consulate) in your country or notarized by a notary office in China. * 5. Bank statement Photocopy of the bank statement with signature * 6. Physical examination record for foreigner Physical examination record for foreigner You can download a template or sample from here . * 7. Passport first page, visa page (please ensure continuity). Tips: For applicants who are in China: If you are an employee, you still need to provide employment separation certificate and your current residence permit. If you are a student, you need to provide transfer certificate, leaving certificate, certificate of attendance rate issued by previous school and your current residence permit.
fields.requirements: Entry Requirements Students who have studied Chinese in China for no more than one and a half years may be accepted. Students who have previously studied in China in a degree program and are applying for a lower-level degree will not be accepted. 18-30 years old. Students with records of stay visas will not be accepted.
